Q1b.en:
Using \(\int \frac{dx}{a^2 + x^2} = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) with \(a = 2\):
\(\int_{2}^{2\sqrt{3}} \frac{dx}{4 + x^2} = \frac{1}{2}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{2}\right]_{2}^{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{1}{2}\left(\tan^{-1}\sqrt{3} - \tan^{-1}1\right) = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{\pi}{24}\),
which is the choice \(\frac{\pi}{24}\).
Q1b.hi:
सूत्र \(\int \frac{dx}{a^2 + x^2} = \frac{1}{a}\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) में \(a = 2\) रखने पर:
\(\int_{2}^{2\sqrt{3}} \frac{dx}{4 + x^2} = \frac{1}{2}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{2}\right]_{2}^{2\sqrt{3}} = \frac{1}{2}\left(\tan^{-1}\sqrt{3} - \tan^{-1}1\right) = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{\pi}{24}\),
जो विकल्प \(\frac{\pi}{24}\) है।

Q1c.en:
The pair \((x, y)\) belongs to \(R\) only when \(y = x + 5\) (and then \(y > 5\) holds automatically for \(x \in N\)). For \((4, 9)\): \(4 + 5 = 9\) and \(9 > 5\), so \((4, 9) \in R\). The other pairs fail, since \(6 + 5 = 11 
eq 10\), \(3 + 5 = 8 
eq 6\) and \(2 + 5 = 7 
eq 6\). So the correct statement is \((4, 9) \in R\).

Q1d.en:
Put \(\sin 2x = t\), so \(2\cos 2x\,dx = dt\). When \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\); when \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\), \(t = 1\). Then
\(\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \sin^3 2x \cos 2x\,dx = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1} t^3\,dt = \frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{t^4}{4}\right]_{0}^{1} = \frac{1}{8}\),
which is the choice \(\frac{1}{8}\).

Q1e.en: An impossible event has no favourable outcome, so it is the empty set \(\phi\) and \(P(\phi) = 0\). The answer is the choice 0.
Q1e.hi: असंभव घटना का कोई भी अनुकूल परिणाम नहीं होता, अतः यह रिक्त समुच्चय \(\phi\) है और \(P(\phi) = 0\)। अतः उत्तर विकल्प 0 है।

Q2a.en:
The principal values are \(\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{\pi}{3}\) and \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{\pi}{6}\). Hence
\(\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 2\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{\pi}{3} + 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\).

Q2b.en:
Since \(x > 1\), put \(x = \sec\theta\) with \(\theta \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\). Then \(\sqrt{x^2 - 1} = \sqrt{\sec^2\theta - 1} = \tan\theta\), so
\(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right) = \cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta}\right) = \cot^{-1}(\cot\theta) = \theta = \sec^{-1} x\).
Q2b.hi:
चूँकि \(x > 1\), माना \(x = \sec\theta\), जहाँ \(\theta \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)। तब \(\sqrt{x^2 - 1} = \sqrt{\sec^2\theta - 1} = \tan\theta\), अतः
\(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right) = \cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta}\right) = \cot^{-1}(\cot\theta) = \theta = \sec^{-1} x\)।

Q2c.en: For direction ratios \(a, b, c\) the direction cosines are \(\frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}, \frac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}, \frac{c}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}\). Here \(\sqrt{3^2 + (-2)^2 + (-6)^2} = \sqrt{49} = 7\), so the direction cosines are \(\frac{3}{7}, -\frac{2}{7}, -\frac{6}{7}\) (or \(-\frac{3}{7}, \frac{2}{7}, \frac{6}{7}\) for the opposite direction).

Q2d.en:
Here \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = (1)(1) + (1)(-1) + (-1)(1) = -1\), \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{3}\) and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{3}\). So
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{-1}{3}\),
and the angle between the vectors is \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\), that is, \(\pi - \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\).
Q2d.hi:
यहाँ \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = (1)(1) + (1)(-1) + (-1)(1) = -1\), \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{3}\) तथा \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{3}\)। अतः
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{-1}{3}\),
और सदिशों के बीच का कोण \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\) अर्थात् \(\pi - \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) है।

Q2e.en:
Here \(f'(x) = 3x^2 - 12x + 12 = 3(x^2 - 4x + 4) = 3(x - 2)^2\).
So \(f'(x) \geq 0\) for every \(x \in R\), and \(f'(x) = 0\) only at the single point \(x = 2\). Hence \(f\) is (strictly) increasing on \(R\).

Q3a.en:
Two vectors are perpendicular when their dot product is zero.
\(\vec{a} + \vec{b} = (5 + 1)\hat{i} + (-1 + 3)\hat{j} + (-3 - 5)\hat{k} = 6\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}\)
\(\vec{a} - \vec{b} = (5 - 1)\hat{i} + (-1 - 3)\hat{j} + (-3 + 5)\hat{k} = 4\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} - \vec{b}) = (6)(4) + (2)(-4) + (-8)(2) = 24 - 8 - 16 = 0\).
Hence \((\vec{a} + \vec{b})\) and \((\vec{a} - \vec{b})\) are perpendicular.

Q3b.en:
For independent events \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\).
(i) \(P(A \cap B) = 0.3 \times 0.4 = 0.12\).
(ii) \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = 0.3 + 0.4 - 0.12 = 0.58\).
Q3b.hi:
स्वतंत्र घटनाओं के लिए \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\)।
(i) \(P(A \cap B) = 0.3 \times 0.4 = 0.12\)।
(ii) \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = 0.3 + 0.4 - 0.12 = 0.58\)।

Q3c.en:
Reflexive: \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3) \in R\), so \((a, a) \in R\) for every \(a \in \{1, 2, 3\}\). Hence \(R\) is reflexive.
Not symmetric: \((1, 2) \in R\) but \((2, 1) \notin R\). Hence \(R\) is not symmetric.
Not transitive: \((1, 2) \in R\) and \((2, 3) \in R\), but \((1, 3) \notin R\). Hence \(R\) is not transitive.
Thus \(R\) is reflexive but neither symmetric nor transitive.
Q3c.hi:
स्वतुल्य: \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3) \in R\), अर्थात् प्रत्येक \(a \in \{1, 2, 3\}\) के लिए \((a, a) \in R\)। अतः \(R\) स्वतुल्य है।
सममित नहीं: \((1, 2) \in R\) परन्तु \((2, 1) \notin R\)। अतः \(R\) सममित नहीं है।
संक्रामक नहीं: \((1, 2) \in R\) तथा \((2, 3) \in R\), परन्तु \((1, 3) \notin R\)। अतः \(R\) संक्रामक नहीं है।
इस प्रकार \(R\) स्वतुल्य है परन्तु न तो सममित है और न संक्रामक।

Q3d.en:
Given \(\sin^{-1}(1 - x) - 2\sin^{-1} x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), so \(\sin^{-1}(1 - x) = \frac{\pi}{2} + 2\sin^{-1} x\).
Taking sine of both sides: \(1 - x = \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + 2\sin^{-1} x\right) = \cos(2\sin^{-1} x)\).
Put \(\sin^{-1} x = y\), so \(x = \sin y\) and \(\cos 2y = 1 - 2\sin^2 y = 1 - 2x^2\).
Thus \(1 - x = 1 - 2x^2\), i.e. \(2x^2 - x = 0\), i.e. \(x(2x - 1) = 0\), so \(x = 0\) or \(x = \frac{1}{2}\).
Check: for \(x = \frac{1}{2}\), \(\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{2} - 2\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{2} = -\frac{\pi}{6} \neq \frac{\pi}{2}\), so it is rejected. For \(x = 0\), \(\sin^{-1} 1 - 0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\), which satisfies the equation.
Hence \(x = 0\).

Q4b.en:
Multiplying each matrix by its scalar:
\(\cos\theta \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\theta & \sin\theta\cos\theta \\ -\sin\theta\cos\theta & \cos^2\theta \end{bmatrix}\)
\(\sin\theta \begin{bmatrix} \sin\theta & -\cos\theta \\ \cos\theta & \sin\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \sin^2\theta & -\sin\theta\cos\theta \\ \sin\theta\cos\theta & \sin^2\theta \end{bmatrix}\)
Adding: \(\begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta & 0 \\ 0 & \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I\), the identity matrix of order 2.
Q4b.hi:
प्रत्येक आव्यूह को उसके अदिश से गुणा करने पर:
\(\cos\theta \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\theta & \sin\theta\cos\theta \\ -\sin\theta\cos\theta & \cos^2\theta \end{bmatrix}\)
\(\sin\theta \begin{bmatrix} \sin\theta & -\cos\theta \\ \cos\theta & \sin\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \sin^2\theta & -\sin\theta\cos\theta \\ \sin\theta\cos\theta & \sin^2\theta \end{bmatrix}\)
जोड़ने पर: \(\begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta & 0 \\ 0 & \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I\), जो कोटि 2 का तत्समक आव्यूह है।

Q4c.en:
Put \(x = a\tan\theta\), so \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) (taking \(a > 0\) and \(-\frac{a}{\sqrt{3}} < x < \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}\), so that \(-\frac{\pi}{6} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{6}\)). Then
\(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2} = \frac{3a^3\tan\theta - a^3\tan^3\theta}{a^3 - 3a^3\tan^2\theta} = \frac{3\tan\theta - \tan^3\theta}{1 - 3\tan^2\theta} = \tan 3\theta\).
So \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2}\right) = \tan^{-1}(\tan 3\theta) = 3\theta = 3\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\).
Q4c.hi:
माना \(x = a\tan\theta\), तब \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) (\(a > 0\) तथा \(-\frac{a}{\sqrt{3}} < x < \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}\) लेने पर \(-\frac{\pi}{6} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{6}\))। तब
\(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2} = \frac{3a^3\tan\theta - a^3\tan^3\theta}{a^3 - 3a^3\tan^2\theta} = \frac{3\tan\theta - \tan^3\theta}{1 - 3\tan^2\theta} = \tan 3\theta\)।
अतः \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3a^2x - x^3}{a^3 - 3ax^2}\right) = \tan^{-1}(\tan 3\theta) = 3\theta = 3\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\)।

Q4d.en:
Find the vectors joining the points in pairs, using their position vectors.
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (1 - 2)\hat{i} + (-2 - 3)\hat{j} + (3 + 4)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{BC} = (3 - 1)\hat{i} + (8 + 2)\hat{j} + (-11 - 3)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} + 10\hat{j} - 14\hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{AC} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (8 - 3)\hat{j} + (-11 + 4)\hat{k} = \hat{i} + 5\hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
So \(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1 + 25 + 49} = 5\sqrt{3}\), \(|\overrightarrow{BC}| = \sqrt{4 + 100 + 196} = 10\sqrt{3}\), \(|\overrightarrow{AC}| = 5\sqrt{3}\).
Since \(|\overrightarrow{BC}| = |\overrightarrow{AB}| + |\overrightarrow{AC}|\) (also \(\overrightarrow{BC} = -2\,\overrightarrow{AB}\)), the points \(A(2, 3, -4)\), \(B(1, -2, 3)\) and \(C(3, 8, -11)\) are collinear.
Q4d.hi:
दिए गए बिन्दुओं के स्थिति सदिश लेकर:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (1 - 2)\hat{i} + (-2 - 3)\hat{j} + (3 + 4)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{BC} = (3 - 1)\hat{i} + (8 + 2)\hat{j} + (-11 - 3)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} + 10\hat{j} - 14\hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{AC} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (8 - 3)\hat{j} + (-11 + 4)\hat{k} = \hat{i} + 5\hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
अतः \(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1 + 25 + 49} = 5\sqrt{3}\), \(|\overrightarrow{BC}| = \sqrt{4 + 100 + 196} = 10\sqrt{3}\), \(|\overrightarrow{AC}| = 5\sqrt{3}\)।
चूँकि \(|\overrightarrow{BC}| = |\overrightarrow{AB}| + |\overrightarrow{AC}|\) (तथा \(\overrightarrow{BC} = -2\,\overrightarrow{AB}\)), अतः बिन्दु \(A(2, 3, -4)\), \(B(1, -2, 3)\) और \(C(3, 8, -11)\) संरेख हैं।

Q5a.en:
Minimise \(Z = 3x + 5y\) subject to \(x + 3y \geq 3\), \(x + y \geq 2\), \(x \geq 0\), \(y \geq 0\).
Step 1 (boundary lines): \(x + 3y = 3\) passes through \((3, 0)\) and \((0, 1)\); \(x + y = 2\) passes through \((2, 0)\) and \((0, 2)\). Since \((0, 0)\) does not satisfy either inequality, each half-plane lies on the side of its line away from the origin.
Step 2 (feasible region): the region in the first quadrant lying above both lines. It is unbounded.
Step 3 (corner points): the lines meet where \(x + 3y = 3\) and \(x + y = 2\); subtracting, \(2y = 1\), so \(y = \frac{1}{2}\) and \(x = \frac{3}{2}\). The corner points are \((0, 2)\), \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\) and \((3, 0)\).
Step 4 (value of \(Z\)):

| Corner point | \(Z = 3x + 5y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 2)\) | \(10\) |
| \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\) | \(\frac{9}{2} + \frac{5}{2} = 7\) (smallest) |
| \((3, 0)\) | \(9\) |

Step 5: since the region is unbounded, draw the half-plane \(3x + 5y < 7\). It has no point in common with the feasible region, so 7 is the minimum.
Hence the minimum value of \(Z\) is 7, at \(x = \frac{3}{2}\), \(y = \frac{1}{2}\).
Q5a.hi:
अवरोधों \(x + 3y \geq 3\), \(x + y \geq 2\), \(x \geq 0\), \(y \geq 0\) के अंतर्गत \(Z = 3x + 5y\) का न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात करना है।
चरण 1 (सीमा रेखाएँ): रेखा \(x + 3y = 3\) बिन्दुओं \((3, 0)\) और \((0, 1)\) से होकर जाती है; रेखा \(x + y = 2\) बिन्दुओं \((2, 0)\) और \((0, 2)\) से होकर जाती है। मूल बिन्दु \((0, 0)\) किसी भी असमिका को संतुष्ट नहीं करता, अतः प्रत्येक अर्धतल अपनी रेखा के मूल बिन्दु से दूर वाली ओर है।
चरण 2 (सुसंगत क्षेत्र): प्रथम चतुर्थांश में दोनों रेखाओं के ऊपर स्थित क्षेत्र। यह अपरिबद्ध है।
चरण 3 (कोनीय बिन्दु): रेखाएँ \(x + 3y = 3\) तथा \(x + y = 2\) को घटाने पर \(2y = 1\), अतः \(y = \frac{1}{2}\) तथा \(x = \frac{3}{2}\)। कोनीय बिन्दु \((0, 2)\), \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\) तथा \((3, 0)\) हैं।
चरण 4 (\(Z\) के मान):

| कोनीय बिन्दु | \(Z = 3x + 5y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 2)\) | \(10\) |
| \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\) | \(\frac{9}{2} + \frac{5}{2} = 7\) (न्यूनतम) |
| \((3, 0)\) | \(9\) |

चरण 5: क्षेत्र अपरिबद्ध है, अतः अर्धतल \(3x + 5y < 7\) खींचते हैं। इसका सुसंगत क्षेत्र से कोई उभयनिष्ठ बिन्दु नहीं है, अतः 7 ही न्यूनतम मान है।
अतः \(Z\) का न्यूनतम मान 7 है, जो \(x = \frac{3}{2}\), \(y = \frac{1}{2}\) पर प्राप्त होता है।

Q5b.en:
**Note:** The English print gives the second line as \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\), while the Hindi print (as in NCERT) gives \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\); the working below solves the English print first and then the Hindi print.

For lines \(\vec{r} = \vec{a_1} + \lambda\vec{b_1}\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a_2} + \mu\vec{b_2}\), the shortest distance is
\(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1})}{|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}|}\right|\).

**As printed in English.** Here \(\vec{a_1} = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b_1} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a_2} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b_2} = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\).
\(\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(2 + 5) - \hat{j}(-4 - 3) + \hat{k}(-10 + 3) = 7\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}| = \sqrt{49 + 49 + 49} = 7\sqrt{3}\)
\((\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1}) = 7(1) + 7(-2) + (-7)(-1) = 7 - 14 + 7 = 0\)
So \(d = \frac{0}{7\sqrt{3}} = 0\). The minimum distance is 0: the lines are not parallel and they intersect (at the point \(\left(\frac{5}{7}, \frac{8}{7}, -\frac{1}{7}\right)\), given by \(\lambda = -\frac{1}{7}\), \(\mu = -\frac{3}{7}\)).

**As printed in Hindi.** Here \(\vec{a_2} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b_2} = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), with \(\vec{a_1}\), \(\vec{b_1}\) as before.
\(\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1} = \hat{i} - \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 + 5) - \hat{j}(4 - 3) + \hat{k}(-10 + 3) = 3\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 49} = \sqrt{59}\)
\((\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1}) = 3(1) + (-1)(0) + (-7)(-1) = 10\)
So \(d = \frac{10}{\sqrt{59}}\) units.
Q5b.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न-पत्र में दूसरी रेखा \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\) छपी है, जबकि हिन्दी प्रश्न-पत्र में (NCERT के अनुसार) \(\vec{r} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k} + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) छपी है; नीचे पहले अंग्रेज़ी वाला रूप और फिर हिन्दी वाला रूप हल किया गया है।

रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = \vec{a_1} + \lambda\vec{b_1}\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a_2} + \mu\vec{b_2}\) के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी
\(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1})}{|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}|}\right|\) होती है।

**अंग्रेज़ी में छपा रूप।** यहाँ \(\vec{a_1} = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b_1} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a_2} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b_2} = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\)।
\(\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(2 + 5) - \hat{j}(-4 - 3) + \hat{k}(-10 + 3) = 7\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}| = \sqrt{49 + 49 + 49} = 7\sqrt{3}\)
\((\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1}) = 7(1) + 7(-2) + (-7)(-1) = 7 - 14 + 7 = 0\)
अतः \(d = \frac{0}{7\sqrt{3}} = 0\)। न्यूनतम दूरी 0 है: रेखाएँ समांतर नहीं हैं और परस्पर प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं (बिन्दु \(\left(\frac{5}{7}, \frac{8}{7}, -\frac{1}{7}\right)\) पर, जहाँ \(\lambda = -\frac{1}{7}\), \(\mu = -\frac{3}{7}\))।

**हिन्दी में छपा रूप।** यहाँ \(\vec{a_2} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b_2} = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), तथा \(\vec{a_1}\), \(\vec{b_1}\) पहले जैसे।
\(\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1} = \hat{i} - \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 + 5) - \hat{j}(4 - 3) + \hat{k}(-10 + 3) = 3\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 49} = \sqrt{59}\)
\((\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}) \cdot (\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1}) = 3(1) + (-1)(0) + (-7)(-1) = 10\)
अतः \(d = \frac{10}{\sqrt{59}}\) इकाई।

Q5c.en:
Given \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\).
Differentiating with respect to \(x\): \(\frac{dy}{dx} = Ame^{mx} + Bne^{nx}\).
Differentiating again: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = Am^2e^{mx} + Bn^2e^{nx}\).
Now
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny\)
\(= Am^2e^{mx} + Bn^2e^{nx} - (m + n)(Ame^{mx} + Bne^{nx}) + mn(Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx})\)
\(= Ae^{mx}\left(m^2 - m^2 - mn + mn\right) + Be^{nx}\left(n^2 - mn - n^2 + mn\right)\)
\(= 0\).
Hence \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\).
Q5c.hi:
दिया है \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\)।
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = Ame^{mx} + Bne^{nx}\)।
पुनः अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = Am^2e^{mx} + Bn^2e^{nx}\)।
अब
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny\)
\(= Am^2e^{mx} + Bn^2e^{nx} - (m + n)(Ame^{mx} + Bne^{nx}) + mn(Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx})\)
\(= Ae^{mx}\left(m^2 - m^2 - mn + mn\right) + Be^{nx}\left(n^2 - mn - n^2 + mn\right)\)
\(= 0\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\)।

Q5d.en:
For continuity at \(x = 3\) we need left-hand limit = right-hand limit = \(f(3)\).
Value: \(f(3) = 3a + 1\).
Left-hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^-} (ax + 1) = 3a + 1\).
Right-hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 3^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^+} (bx + 3) = 3b + 3\).
So \(3a + 1 = 3b + 3\), i.e. \(3a - 3b = 2\), i.e. \(a = b + \frac{2}{3}\).
Hence \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 3\) for all values of \(a\) and \(b\) satisfying \(a = b + \frac{2}{3}\) (for example \(b = 0\), \(a = \frac{2}{3}\)); there are infinitely many such pairs.

Q5e.en:
Let \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 18 & 22 & -13 \\ 7 & -9 & 11 \\ -11 & 7 & 17 \end{vmatrix}\). Expanding along the first row:
\(\Delta = 18\begin{vmatrix} -9 & 11 \\ 7 & 17 \end{vmatrix} - 22\begin{vmatrix} 7 & 11 \\ -11 & 17 \end{vmatrix} + (-13)\begin{vmatrix} 7 & -9 \\ -11 & 7 \end{vmatrix}\)
\(= 18(-153 - 77) - 22(119 + 121) - 13(49 - 99)\)
\(= 18(-230) - 22(240) - 13(-50)\)
\(= -4140 - 5280 + 650\)
\(= -8770\).
Hence the value of the determinant is \(-8770\).

Q6a.en:
Since \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\),
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\).
Expanding: \(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\).
Putting the values: \(9 + 16 + 4 + 2\mu = 0\), so \(2\mu = -29\).
Hence \(\mu = -\frac{29}{2}\).
Q6a.hi:
चूँकि \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\),
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)।
प्रसार करने पर: \(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)।
मान रखने पर: \(9 + 16 + 4 + 2\mu = 0\), अतः \(2\mu = -29\)।
अतः \(\mu = -\frac{29}{2}\)।

Q6b.en:
Let the cylinder inscribed in the sphere of radius \(R\) have height \(h\) and base radius \(r\). The centre of the sphere is the mid-point of the axis of the cylinder, so a radius of the sphere drawn to the rim of the base gives a right triangle with sides \(r\), \(\frac{h}{2}\) and hypotenuse \(R\):
\(r^2 + \frac{h^2}{4} = R^2\), so \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\).
Volume of the cylinder: \(V = \pi r^2 h = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\right)h = \pi\left(R^2h - \frac{h^3}{4}\right)\).
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{3h^2}{4}\right)\), \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi h}{2}\).
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\): \(R^2 = \frac{3h^2}{4}\), so \(h^2 = \frac{4R^2}{3}\) and \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) (height is positive).
At \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\), \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi}{2} \cdot \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}} = -\sqrt{3}\pi R < 0\), so the volume is maximum there.
Hence the height of the cylinder of maximum volume is \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) (and the maximum volume is \(\frac{4\pi R^3}{3\sqrt{3}}\)).
Q6b.hi:
माना \(R\) त्रिज्या के गोले के अंतर्गत बेलन की ऊँचाई \(h\) तथा आधार की त्रिज्या \(r\) है। गोले का केन्द्र बेलन के अक्ष का मध्य-बिन्दु है, अतः आधार की परिधि तक खींची गई गोले की त्रिज्या भुजाओं \(r\), \(\frac{h}{2}\) तथा कर्ण \(R\) वाला समकोण त्रिभुज बनाती है:
\(r^2 + \frac{h^2}{4} = R^2\), अतः \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\)।
बेलन का आयतन: \(V = \pi r^2 h = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\right)h = \pi\left(R^2h - \frac{h^3}{4}\right)\)।
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{3h^2}{4}\right)\), \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi h}{2}\)।
उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\): \(R^2 = \frac{3h^2}{4}\), अतः \(h^2 = \frac{4R^2}{3}\) तथा \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) (ऊँचाई धनात्मक है)।
\(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) पर \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi}{2} \cdot \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}} = -\sqrt{3}\pi R < 0\), अतः यहाँ आयतन अधिकतम है।
अतः अधिकतम आयतन के बेलन की ऊँचाई \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) है (तथा अधिकतम आयतन \(\frac{4\pi R^3}{3\sqrt{3}}\) है)।

Q6c.en:
Let \(u = x^{\sin x}\) and \(v = (\cos x)^{\tan x}\), so \(y = u + v\) and \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{du}{dx} + \frac{dv}{dx}\).
For \(u\): \(\log u = \sin x \log x\). Differentiating, \(\frac{1}{u}\frac{du}{dx} = \cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\), so
\(\frac{du}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\).
For \(v\): \(\log v = \tan x \log(\cos x)\). Differentiating, \(\frac{1}{v}\frac{dv}{dx} = \sec^2 x \log(\cos x) + \tan x \cdot \frac{-\sin x}{\cos x} = \sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\), so
\(\frac{dv}{dx} = (\cos x)^{\tan x}\left(\sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\right)\).
Hence
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right) + (\cos x)^{\tan x}\left(\sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\right)\).
Q6c.hi:
माना \(u = x^{\sin x}\) तथा \(v = (\cos x)^{\tan x}\), तब \(y = u + v\) और \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{du}{dx} + \frac{dv}{dx}\)।
\(u\) के लिए: \(\log u = \sin x \log x\)। अवकलन करने पर \(\frac{1}{u}\frac{du}{dx} = \cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\), अतः
\(\frac{du}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\)।
\(v\) के लिए: \(\log v = \tan x \log(\cos x)\)। अवकलन करने पर \(\frac{1}{v}\frac{dv}{dx} = \sec^2 x \log(\cos x) + \tan x \cdot \frac{-\sin x}{\cos x} = \sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\), अतः
\(\frac{dv}{dx} = (\cos x)^{\tan x}\left(\sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\right)\)।
अतः
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right) + (\cos x)^{\tan x}\left(\sec^2 x \log(\cos x) - \tan^2 x\right)\)।

Q6d.en:
Since \(E\) and \(F\) are independent, \(P(E \cap F) = P(E) \cdot P(F)\).
The events \(E \cap F\) and \(E \cap F'\) are mutually exclusive and \(E = (E \cap F) \cup (E \cap F')\). So
\(P(E) = P(E \cap F) + P(E \cap F')\)
\(P(E \cap F') = P(E) - P(E \cap F) = P(E) - P(E) \cdot P(F) = P(E)\left(1 - P(F)\right) = P(E) \cdot P(F')\).
Hence \(E\) and \(F'\) are independent.
Q6d.hi:
चूँकि \(E\) और \(F\) स्वतंत्र हैं, अतः \(P(E \cap F) = P(E) \cdot P(F)\)।
घटनाएँ \(E \cap F\) तथा \(E \cap F'\) परस्पर अपवर्जी हैं और \(E = (E \cap F) \cup (E \cap F')\)। अतः
\(P(E) = P(E \cap F) + P(E \cap F')\)
\(P(E \cap F') = P(E) - P(E \cap F) = P(E) - P(E) \cdot P(F) = P(E)\left(1 - P(F)\right) = P(E) \cdot P(F')\)।
अतः \(E\) और \(F'\) भी स्वतंत्र हैं।

Q6e.en:
The line \(y = 3x + 2\) meets the \(x\)-axis at \(x = -\frac{2}{3}\). For \(-1 \leq x < -\frac{2}{3}\) the line lies below the \(x\)-axis and for \(-\frac{2}{3} < x \leq 1\) it lies above, so the area is taken in two parts.
\(A_1 = \left|\int_{-1}^{-2/3} (3x + 2)\,dx\right| = \left|\left[\frac{3x^2}{2} + 2x\right]_{-1}^{-2/3}\right| = \left|\left(\frac{2}{3} - \frac{4}{3}\right) - \left(\frac{3}{2} - 2\right)\right| = \left|-\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{2}\right| = \frac{1}{6}\)
\(A_2 = \int_{-2/3}^{1} (3x + 2)\,dx = \left[\frac{3x^2}{2} + 2x\right]_{-2/3}^{1} = \left(\frac{3}{2} + 2\right) - \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right) = \frac{7}{2} + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{25}{6}\)
Required area \(= \frac{1}{6} + \frac{25}{6} = \frac{26}{6} = \frac{13}{3}\) square units.
Q6e.hi:
रेखा \(y = 3x + 2\), \(x\)-अक्ष को \(x = -\frac{2}{3}\) पर काटती है। \(-1 \leq x < -\frac{2}{3}\) के लिए रेखा \(x\)-अक्ष के नीचे और \(-\frac{2}{3} < x \leq 1\) के लिए ऊपर है, अतः क्षेत्रफल दो भागों में लिया जाता है।
\(A_1 = \left|\int_{-1}^{-2/3} (3x + 2)\,dx\right| = \left|\left[\frac{3x^2}{2} + 2x\right]_{-1}^{-2/3}\right| = \left|\left(\frac{2}{3} - \frac{4}{3}\right) - \left(\frac{3}{2} - 2\right)\right| = \left|-\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{2}\right| = \frac{1}{6}\)
\(A_2 = \int_{-2/3}^{1} (3x + 2)\,dx = \left[\frac{3x^2}{2} + 2x\right]_{-2/3}^{1} = \left(\frac{3}{2} + 2\right) - \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right) = \frac{7}{2} + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{25}{6}\)
अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{1}{6} + \frac{25}{6} = \frac{26}{6} = \frac{13}{3}\) वर्ग इकाई।

Q7b.en:
Any square matrix can be written as \(\frac{1}{2}(B + B') + \frac{1}{2}(B - B')\), where the first part is symmetric and the second skew-symmetric.
\(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\), \(B' = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & -2 \\ -4 & 4 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(P = \frac{1}{2}(B + B') = \frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & -3 & -3 \\ -3 & 6 & 2 \\ -3 & 2 & -6 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{3}{2} \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 3 & 1 \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 1 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(P' = P\), so \(P\) is symmetric.
\(Q = \frac{1}{2}(B - B') = \frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & -5 \\ 1 & 0 & 6 \\ 5 & -6 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 3 \\ \frac{5}{2} & -3 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(Q' = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & \frac{1}{2} & \frac{5}{2} \\ -\frac{1}{2} & 0 & -3 \\ -\frac{5}{2} & 3 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = -Q\), so \(Q\) is skew-symmetric.
Now \(P + Q = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\), which is the matrix \(B\).
Hence \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{3}{2} \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 3 & 1 \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 1 & -3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 3 \\ \frac{5}{2} & -3 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\), the sum of a symmetric and a skew-symmetric matrix.
Q7b.hi:
किसी भी वर्ग आव्यूह को \(\frac{1}{2}(B + B') + \frac{1}{2}(B - B')\) के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है, जहाँ पहला भाग सममित तथा दूसरा विषम सममित होता है।
\(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\), \(B' = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & -2 \\ -4 & 4 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(P = \frac{1}{2}(B + B') = \frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & -3 & -3 \\ -3 & 6 & 2 \\ -3 & 2 & -6 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{3}{2} \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 3 & 1 \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 1 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(P' = P\), अतः \(P\) सममित आव्यूह है।
\(Q = \frac{1}{2}(B - B') = \frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & -5 \\ 1 & 0 & 6 \\ 5 & -6 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 3 \\ \frac{5}{2} & -3 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(Q' = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & \frac{1}{2} & \frac{5}{2} \\ -\frac{1}{2} & 0 & -3 \\ -\frac{5}{2} & 3 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = -Q\), अतः \(Q\) विषम सममित आव्यूह है।
अब \(P + Q = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -2 & -4 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\), जो आव्यूह \(B\) है।
अतः \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{3}{2} \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 3 & 1 \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 1 & -3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 3 \\ \frac{5}{2} & -3 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\), जो एक सममित तथा एक विषम सममित आव्यूह का योगफल है।

Q8a.en:
Expanding the equation:
\(xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dy - y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dx = xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dx + x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dy\)
\(\left[xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]dy = \left[xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]dx\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)}{xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)}\).
The right side is a function of \(\frac{y}{x}\) only, so the equation is homogeneous. Put \(y = vx\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\). Dividing numerator and denominator by \(x^2\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v\cos v + v^2\sin v}{v\sin v - \cos v}\)
\(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v\cos v + v^2\sin v - v^2\sin v + v\cos v}{v\sin v - \cos v} = \frac{2v\cos v}{v\sin v - \cos v}\).
Separating the variables:
\(\frac{v\sin v - \cos v}{v\cos v}\,dv = \frac{2\,dx}{x}\), i.e. \(\left(\tan v - \frac{1}{v}\right)dv = \frac{2\,dx}{x}\).
Integrating:
\(-\log|\cos v| - \log|v| = 2\log|x| + \log|C_1|\)
\(\log\left|\frac{1}{v\cos v}\right| = \log|C_1x^2|\), so \(\frac{1}{v\cos v} = \pm C_1x^2\), i.e. \(x^2 v\cos v = C\) (where \(C = \pm\frac{1}{C_1}\)).
Putting \(v = \frac{y}{x}\): \(x^2 \cdot \frac{y}{x}\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = C\).
Hence the general solution is \(xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = C\).
Q8a.hi:
समीकरण का प्रसार करने पर:
\(xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dy - y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dx = xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dx + x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)dy\)
\(\left[xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]dy = \left[xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]dx\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + y^2\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)}{xy\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - x^2\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)}\)।
दायाँ पक्ष केवल \(\frac{y}{x}\) का फलन है, अतः यह समघातीय अवकल समीकरण है। माना \(y = vx\), तब \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\)। अंश और हर को \(x^2\) से भाग देने पर:
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v\cos v + v^2\sin v}{v\sin v - \cos v}\)
\(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v\cos v + v^2\sin v - v^2\sin v + v\cos v}{v\sin v - \cos v} = \frac{2v\cos v}{v\sin v - \cos v}\)।
चरों को पृथक करने पर:
\(\frac{v\sin v - \cos v}{v\cos v}\,dv = \frac{2\,dx}{x}\), अर्थात् \(\left(\tan v - \frac{1}{v}\right)dv = \frac{2\,dx}{x}\)।
समाकलन करने पर:
\(-\log|\cos v| - \log|v| = 2\log|x| + \log|C_1|\)
\(\log\left|\frac{1}{v\cos v}\right| = \log|C_1x^2|\), अतः \(\frac{1}{v\cos v} = \pm C_1x^2\), अर्थात् \(x^2 v\cos v = C\) (जहाँ \(C = \pm\frac{1}{C_1}\))।
\(v = \frac{y}{x}\) रखने पर: \(x^2 \cdot \frac{y}{x}\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = C\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(xy\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = C\) है।

Q9a.en:
The integrand is an improper fraction, since \((x - 1)(x^2 + 1) = x^3 - x^2 + x - 1\). Dividing: \((x + 1)(x^3 - x^2 + x - 1) = x^4 - 1\), so
\(\frac{x^4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)} = x + 1 + \frac{1}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)}\).
Partial fractions: let \(\frac{1}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)} = \frac{p}{x - 1} + \frac{qx + r}{x^2 + 1}\), so \(1 = p(x^2 + 1) + (qx + r)(x - 1)\).
Putting \(x = 1\): \(1 = 2p\), so \(p = \frac{1}{2}\).
Comparing coefficients of \(x^2\): \(p + q = 0\), so \(q = -\frac{1}{2}\).
Comparing constant terms: \(p - r = 1\), so \(r = -\frac{1}{2}\).
Thus \(\frac{x^4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)} = x + 1 + \frac{1}{2(x - 1)} - \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{x}{x^2 + 1} - \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{x^2 + 1}\).
Integrating term by term:
\(\int \frac{x^4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 1)}\,dx = \frac{x^2}{2} + x + \frac{1}{2}\log|x - 1| - \frac{1}{4}\log(x^2 + 1) - \frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1} x + C\),
where \(C\) is the constant of integration.

Q9b.en:
Separating the variables:
\(\frac{dy}{y^2 + y + 1} + \frac{dx}{x^2 + x + 1} = 0\).
Since \(y^2 + y + 1 = \left(y + \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2\) and similarly for \(x\), integrating gives
\(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2y + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) + \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2x + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = C_1\)
\(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2x + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) + \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{2y + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\).
Using \(\tan^{-1} p + \tan^{-1} q = \tan^{-1}\frac{p + q}{1 - pq}\):
\(\frac{p + q}{1 - pq} = \frac{\frac{2x + 2y + 2}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 - \frac{(2x + 1)(2y + 1)}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2(x + y + 1)}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{3 - 4xy - 2x - 2y - 1}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2(x + y + 1)}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{2(1 - x - y - 2xy)}{3}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy}\).
So \(\tan^{-1}\left[\frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy}\right] = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\), i.e.
\(\frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy} = \tan\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\right)\).
Putting \(A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\tan\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\right)\):
\(x + y + 1 = A(1 - x - y - 2xy)\),
which is the required general solution, \(A\) being a parameter.

\(\tan^{-1} p + \tan^{-1} q = \tan^{-1}\frac{p + q}{1 - pq}\) का प्रयोग करने पर:
\(\frac{p + q}{1 - pq} = \frac{\frac{2x + 2y + 2}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 - \frac{(2x + 1)(2y + 1)}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2(x + y + 1)}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{3 - 4xy - 2x - 2y - 1}{3}} = \frac{\frac{2(x + y + 1)}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{2(1 - x - y - 2xy)}{3}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy}\)।
अतः \(\tan^{-1}\left[\frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy}\right] = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\), अर्थात्
\(\frac{\sqrt{3}(x + y + 1)}{1 - x - y - 2xy} = \tan\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\right)\)।
\(A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\tan\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}C_1\right)\) रखने पर:
